questions.stem_md: Shar markazidan $5$ masofada o'tuvchi tekislik sharni yuzi $16\pi$ bo'lgan doira bo'yicha kesadi. Shar sirtining yuzini toping.

questions.solution_md:
Kesim radiusi $r$: $\pi r^2=16\pi$, demak $r=4$.

Shar radiusi, markazdan kesim markazigacha masofa va kesim radiusi to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak hosil qiladi: $R^2=r^2+d^2=16+25=41$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot41=164\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: $R^2=r^2-d^2$ deb olish: Pifagor teoremasida shar radiusi gipotenuza, ya'ni eng katta tomon.

ru.solution_md:
Радиус сечения $r$: $\pi r^2=16\pi$, значит $r=4$.

Радиус шара, расстояние до плоскости и радиус сечения образуют прямоугольный треугольник: $R^2=r^2+d^2=16+25=41$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot41=164\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Писать $R^2=r^2-d^2$: радиус шара — гипотенуза, то есть наибольшая сторона треугольника.

Kesim radiusı $r$: $\pi r^2=16\pi$, demek $r=4$.

Shar radiusı, oraydan kesim orayına shekemgi aralıq hám kesim radiusı tuwrı múyeshli úshmúyeshlik payda etedi: $R^2=r^2+d^2=16+25=41$.

en.stem_md: A plane at distance $5$ from the center of a ball cuts the ball in a disk of area $16\pi$. Find the surface area of the ball.

en.solution_md:
The radius of the section is $r$: $\pi r^2=16\pi$, so $r=4$.

The radius of the ball, the distance to the plane and the section radius form a right triangle: $R^2=r^2+d^2=16+25=41$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot41=164\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing $R^2=r^2-d^2$: the radius of the ball is the hypotenuse, the longest side.

questions.stem_md: Shar markazining ikki tomonida joylashgan ikkita parallel tekislik sharni radiuslari $8$ va $6$ bo'lgan doiralar bo'yicha kesadi. Tekisliklar orasidagi masofa $14$ ga teng.

a.hint: Javobni butun son yoki oddiy kasr (masalan 7/3) ko'rinishida yozing.

b.prompt_md: Shar hajmini $\pi$ ga bo'lib, hosil bo'lgan sonni toping.
b.hint: Javobni butun son yoki oddiy kasr (masalan 7/3) ko'rinishida yozing.

questions.solution_md:
a) Markazdan tekisliklargacha masofalar $x$ va $14-x$. $R^2=8^2+x^2=6^2+(14-x)^2$, bundan $x=\frac{14^2+6^2-8^2}{2\cdot14}=6$. $R^2=64+36=100$, $R=10$.

b) $\frac V\pi=\frac43R^3=\frac43\cdot1000=\frac{4000}{3}$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Tekisliklar orasidagi masofani markazdan bir tekislikkacha masofa deb olish; $R=r_1+r_2$ yoki $R=\frac t2$ deb taxmin qilish.

ru.stem_md: Две параллельные плоскости, расположенные по разные стороны от центра шара, пересекают шар по кругам радиусов $8$ и $6$. Расстояние между плоскостями равно $14$.

b.prompt_md: Найдите объём шара, делённый на $\pi$.

Shar radiusı, oraydan kesim orayına shekemgi aralıq hám kesim radiusı tuwrı múyeshli úshmúyeshlik payda etedi: $R^2=r^2+d^2=16+9=25$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot25=100\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: $R^2=r^2-d^2$ dep alıw: Pifagor teoremasında shar radiusı gipotenuza, yaǵnıy eń úlken tárep.

en.solution_md:
The radius of the section is $r$: $\pi r^2=16\pi$, so $r=4$.

The radius of the ball, the distance to the plane and the section radius form a right triangle: $R^2=r^2+d^2=16+9=25$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot25=100\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing $R^2=r^2-d^2$: the radius of the ball is the hypotenuse, the longest side.

kaa.stem_md: Shar orayınan $3$ aralıqtan ótken tegislik sharni maydanı $100\pi$ bolǵan dóńgelek boyınsha kesedi. Shar betiniń maydanın tabıń.

kaa.solution_md:
Kesim radiusı $r$: $\pi r^2=100\pi$, demek $r=10$.

Shar radiusı, oraydan kesim orayına shekemgi aralıq hám kesim radiusı tuwrı múyeshli úshmúyeshlik payda etedi: $R^2=r^2+d^2=100+9=109$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot109=436\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: $R^2=r^2-d^2$ dep alıw: Pifagor teoremasında shar radiusı gipotenuza, yaǵnıy eń úlken tárep.

en.solution_md:
The radius of the section is $r$: $\pi r^2=100\pi$, so $r=10$.

The radius of the ball, the distance to the plane and the section radius form a right triangle: $R^2=r^2+d^2=100+9=109$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot109=436\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing $R^2=r^2-d^2$: the radius of the ball is the hypotenuse, the longest side.

questions.solution_md:

en.solution_md:
a) The distances from the center to the planes are $x$ and $34-x$. $R^2=24^2+x^2=10^2+(34-x)^2$, so $x=\frac{34^2+10^2-24^2}{2\cdot34}=10$. $R^2=576+100=676$, $R=26$.

b) $\frac V\pi=\frac43R^3=\frac43\cdot17576=\frac{70304}{3}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the distance between the planes as the distance from the center to one of them, or guessing $R=r_1+r_2$ or $R=\frac t2$.

kaa.solution_md:
Kesim radiusı $r$: $\pi r^2=49\pi$, demek $r=7$.

Shar radiusı, oraydan kesim orayına shekemgi aralıq hám kesim radiusı tuwrı múyeshli úshmúyeshlik payda etedi: $R^2=r^2+d^2=49+16=65$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot65=260\pi$.

en.solution_md:
The radius of the section is $r$: $\pi r^2=49\pi$, so $r=7$.

The radius of the ball, the distance to the plane and the section radius form a right triangle: $R^2=r^2+d^2=49+16=65$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot65=260\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing $R^2=r^2-d^2$: the radius of the ball is the hypotenuse, the longest side.

Радиус сечения $r$: $\pi r^2=25\pi$, значит $r=5$.

Радиус шара, расстояние до плоскости и радиус сечения образуют прямоугольный треугольник: $R^2=r^2+d^2=25+81=106$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot106=424\pi$.

ru.solution_md:
Радиус сечения $r$: $\pi r^2=25\pi$, значит $r=5$.

Радиус шара, расстояние до плоскости и радиус сечения образуют прямоугольный треугольник: $R^2=r^2+d^2=25+64=89$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot89=356\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Писать $R^2=r^2-d^2$: радиус шара — гипотенуза, то есть наибольшая сторона треугольника.

Shar radiusı, oraydan kesim orayına shekemgi aralıq hám kesim radiusı tuwrı múyeshli úshmúyeshlik payda etedi: $R^2=r^2+d^2=25+64=89$.

en.solution_md:
The radius of the section is $r$: $\pi r^2=25\pi$, so $r=5$.

The radius of the ball, the distance to the plane and the section radius form a right triangle: $R^2=r^2+d^2=25+64=89$.

$S=4\pi R^2=4\pi\cdot89=356\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing $R^2=r^2-d^2$: the radius of the ball is the hypotenuse, the longest side.
